description: The chart illustrates the effect of context masking on case-related tasks, aggregated by language family, with six model/setting variants shown per family and vertical error bars indicating standard deviation. The horizontal axis contains the language-family categories in the displayed order: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic. The vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear numeric scale with visible tick labels at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30 (values extend slightly below 0 and up to the mid-30s). For each family, the bars are grouped side-by-side in a consistent left-to-right sequence matching the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). Approximate bar heights by family are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (about 2 for mBERT-L₂, ~1 for XLM-L₂, ~3 for mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂, ~6 for mBERT-B₂, and ~5 for XLM-B₂); IE-Germanic shows ~10 for both L₂ bars, near-zero to slightly negative values for both R₂ bars, and ~15 for both B₂ bars; IE-Indic shows ~1 (mBERT-L₂) and ~0 (XLM-L₂), larger R₂ values around ~20 (mBERT-R₂) and ~18 (XLM-R₂), and B₂ values around ~24 (mBERT-B₂) and ~21 (XLM-B₂); IE-Romance shows roughly ~6 (mBERT-L₂), ~4 (XLM-L₂), ~5 (mBERT-R₂), ~1 (XLM-R₂), ~12 (mBERT-B₂), and ~6 (XLM-B₂); IE-Slavic shows about ~10 (mBERT-L₂), ~9 (XLM-L₂), ~1 (mBERT-R₂), near ~0 (XLM-R₂), ~17 (mBERT-B₂), and ~15 (XLM-B₂); IE-other shows about ~6 for both L₂ bars, around ~0 to ~1 for both R₂ bars, and ~8 for both B₂ bars; Isolate shows values near 0 for both L₂ bars and around ~1–2 for the R₂ and B₂ bars; Semitic shows about ~11 (mBERT-L₂), ~16 (XLM-L₂), slightly negative values for both R₂ bars (around −2 to −1), and larger B₂ values near ~15 (mBERT-B₂) and ~19 (XLM-B₂); Uralic shows uniformly small values near ~0.5–1 for most bars, with mBERT-B₂ around ~2 and XLM-B₂ around ~0.5. The categories are not displayed in an explicitly sorted-by-value order, and no individual bars appear specially highlighted beyond the color coding and the error-bar overlays.
